name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: This Classic Margherita Pizza features a charred crust topped with tomato sauce, melted cheese, and fresh basil leaves. The pizza is cooked in a wood-fired style and cut into slices. It is presented on a wooden serving board with a small bowl of tomato sauce and a glass of olive oil on the side.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: Grilled chicken pieces are served in a rich, orange-red sauce and garnished with fresh green herbs in a metallic bowl with handles. The dish is presented on a black slate plate, accompanied by a bowl of white rice and naan bread on the side. Steam rises from the bowl, indicating the dish is hot.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: A bowl of stir-fried vegetables and tofu is presented, featuring broccoli, carrots, snow peas, and cubed tofu in a savory brown sauce. The dish is served in a white bowl alongside a smaller bowl of white rice. Chopsticks are placed to the right of the bowl.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: A Greek salad is presented in a white bowl, featuring a mix of romaine lettuce, sliced tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, Kalamata olives, and crumbled feta cheese. The ingredients appear to be chopped and tossed together, with a silver serving spoon partially submerged in the salad. The bowl is placed on a wooden table, accompanied by a small glass bowl of dressing and a lemon wedge.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: Spaghetti is served in a white bowl, tossed with garlic, parsley, and red pepper flakes, and topped with grated cheese. The dish is presented in a neat, swirled mound. The bowl is placed on a wooden table with a fork beside it.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: Glazed salmon is presented on a wooden cutting board, sliced into portions and topped with a glossy glaze, dill, and spices. The dish is garnished with lemon wedges and surrounded by scattered herbs and spices. A fork is poised to serve the salmon, which is arranged on a metal spatula.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: The Tomato Basil Soup is served in a light blue bowl with a brown rim, garnished with basil leaves and herbs. The vibrant red-orange soup appears to be blended, with visible flecks of herbs and spices. The bowl is surrounded by various ingredients, including fresh tomatoes, basil, garlic, and chili peppers.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: This Pad Thai dish features stir-fried rice noodles, shrimp, scrambled eggs, green onions, and bean sprouts, with visible cashews and chili peppers. The ingredients are cooked together in a wok-style preparation. The dish is presented on a large ceramic plate, garnished with a lime wedge and surrounded by green onions, with various seasonings and ingredients displayed around it.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: Crispy fried falafel patties are arranged on a plate with sliced red onions, lemon, and parsley. The dish is accompanied by a bowl of creamy tahini sauce and various garnishes. The falafel and accompaniments are presented on a decorative plate against a light-colored background.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: Four tacos are arranged on a gray plate, each filled with seasoned ground beef, shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, salsa verde, and sour cream. The tacos are served in yellow corn tortillas, garnished with additional diced tomatoes and cheese scattered around the plate. The plate is accompanied by bowls of salsa, shredded cheese, and sour cream in the background.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: A pan-seared ribeye steak is served in a black skillet, sliced into thick strips and garnished with sprigs of thyme and peppercorns. The steak is accompanied by three cubes of butter on the right side of the skillet. The dish is presented on a dark surface, surrounded by various seasonings and condiments.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: The Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric is a thick, orange-brown stew made with lentils, visible spices, and herbs, served in a ceramic bowl. The dish is garnished with cilantro, sliced onions, cherry tomatoes, and a slice of lime, and topped with a sprinkle of spices. The bowl is placed on a beige cloth napkin, accompanied by a spoon to the side.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: Pan-seared cod is served on a bed of white rice, topped with a brown sauce, sesame seeds, and chopped green onions. The dish is presented in a ceramic bowl with a blue-green glaze, accompanied by a wooden spoon and chopsticks. The meal is garnished with additional sesame seeds and green onions around the cod.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: Grilled chicken pieces are arranged on a wooden platter, garnished with lime slices and fresh herbs. The chicken appears to be seasoned with spices and herbs, and is accompanied by various side dishes and condiments, including rice, beans, and salt. The dish is presented on a rustic wooden platter, surrounded by additional ingredients and spices.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: Penne pasta is served on a ceramic plate, topped with roasted cherry tomatoes, basil leaves, and shaved parmesan cheese. The dish is presented on a rustic table surrounded by ingredients and cooking elements. The plate has a brown and blue glaze, adding to the earthy presentation.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The dish consists of paneer cubes in a rich, red-orange sauce, garnished with sliced onions and fresh herbs, served in a shallow bowl. The paneer appears to be cooked in the sauce, which is likely a butter masala gravy. The dish is presented in a decorative bowl, surrounded by naan bread and various accompaniments.

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: This Falooda dessert drink consists of layered red jelly, thin noodles, and white cream, topped with whipped cream, cherries, and rose petals. The glasses are garnished with decorative spoons and presented on a marble slab surrounded by additional toppings and garnishes. The Falooda is served in tall, ornate glasses with a wide base and narrow top.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: Shakshuka is presented in a black cast-iron skillet, containing eggs poached in a vibrant mixture of sautéed red and green peppers, onions, and tomatoes. The dish is garnished with fresh herbs and spices. The skillet is surrounded by various ingredients and spices, including chili peppers, garlic, and small bowls of seasonings.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: A plate of Cuban Black Beans and Rice is presented with a scoop of white rice surrounded by dark brown beans and slices of garlic, garnished with green leaves. The dish appears to be cooked, with the beans in a savory sauce. The ingredients are arranged artfully on a white plate with a black rim.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: Sliced beef, cooked to medium-rare, is arranged on a plate with onions and garnished with green onions and sesame seeds. The dish appears to be grilled or pan-seared. The beef is served in a shallow gray bowl, surrounded by various accompaniments and ingredients.

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: This Spanish Paella Valenciana features chicken, tomatoes, onions, and saffron-infused rice, cooked together in a large shallow pan. The dish is garnished with rosemary sprigs and red peppers, and is presented in its cooking vessel, surrounded by ingredients and cooking utensils. The paella is arranged in a visually appealing pattern, with the chicken pieces radiating from the center.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: This Tom Yum Goong soup is filled with large shrimp, mushrooms, lemongrass, and sliced red chilies in a light brown broth. The dish is garnished with cilantro and a lime wedge, and a white spoon is partially submerged in the soup. The soup is served in a white ceramic bowl on a wooden table.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: Sliced grilled chicken breast is served on top of a bed of romaine lettuce, croutons, and halved cherry tomatoes, tossed in a creamy dressing and sprinkled with shredded cheese and shaved parmesan. The salad is presented in a dark-colored bowl. The dish is garnished with additional parmesan cheese shavings and black pepper.

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: This moussaka features layers of eggplant slices, ground meat, and melted cheese, baked in a rectangular dish. The dish is garnished with fresh herbs and has a golden-brown crust. It is presented in a metal baking pan, surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings.

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: This bowl of Shoyu Ramen features noodles in a light brown broth, topped with sliced grilled chicken, green onions, black sesame seeds, and two halves of a soft-boiled egg. The ingredients are carefully arranged in a black ceramic bowl, creating a visually appealing presentation. The dish is garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds around the edges.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: Fettuccine pasta is topped with cooked shrimp, sliced green beans, and lemon wedges, and seasoned with herbs and black pepper. The dish is presented on a round, shallow ceramic plate. The pasta and shrimp are arranged in a loose, appetizing manner, surrounded by ingredients and garnishes on the table.

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: The ratatouille is a vibrant vegetable stew featuring sliced eggplant, zucchini, tomatoes, and bell peppers. The ingredients appear to be sautéed or stewed together, showcasing a colorful and textured mixture. The dish is presented in a white bowl, surrounded by fresh vegetables and herbs on a wooden cutting board.

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: Pan-seared salmon fillets with crispy skin are served on a ceramic plate with a side of dill yogurt sauce, garnished with fresh dill and accompanied by lemon wedges. The dish is presented on a rustic wooden table with a beige napkin and utensils. The salmon is seasoned with pepper and garnished with fresh dill.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: The Thai Green Curry with Vegetables is served in a brown ceramic bowl, featuring a vibrant mixture of tofu, sliced peppers, zucchini, and peas in a green curry sauce, accompanied by a side of white rice. The dish is garnished with fresh basil leaves and presented with wooden chopsticks and a spoon. The bowl is surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings, adding to the overall presentation.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: Mango sticky rice is presented in a bowl on a blue plate, consisting of white sticky rice topped with diced mango and a vibrant orange sauce, garnished with green leaves. The dish is accompanied by additional mango pieces and small bowls containing various ingredients. The overall presentation is colorful and appetizing, with the main bowl showcasing the key components of the dessert.

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: This herbed quinoa salad is a mix of cooked quinoa, sliced cucumbers, halved cherry tomatoes, and chopped parsley, presented in a white bowl. The ingredients appear to be lightly tossed together, showcasing a simple yet colorful preparation style. The dish is garnished with additional parsley and served in a bowl surrounded by lemon wedges and a small bowl of yellow dressing.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: A beef shawarma wrap is presented on a dark surface, filled with sliced beef, tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, and lettuce. The ingredients are wrapped in a toasted pita bread, tied with twine. The dish is surrounded by various accompaniments and condiments.

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: Baked chicken breasts are arranged on top of pasta, melted cheese, and a green pesto sauce in a baking dish. The dish is garnished with cherry tomatoes on the vine. The baking dish is accompanied by a spoonful of pesto sauce and utensils on a wooden table.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: Baked eggplant slices are layered in a rectangular baking dish with tomato sauce and cheese, topped with melted cheese and breadcrumbs. The dish is presented in a metal baking pan on a wooden board, surrounded by ingredients. The eggplant parmesan is garnished with herbs and appears to be freshly baked.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: This Moroccan Chickpea Stew is a hearty, slow-cooked dish featuring chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and fresh cilantro in a rich, reddish-brown broth. The stew is served in a decorative ceramic bowl with a brown and blue pattern. Fresh cilantro garnishes the top of the stew, adding a pop of green color.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: The Crunchy Cabbage Slaw is a salad composed of shredded green cabbage and carrots, mixed together and presented in a blue bowl. The ingredients appear to be raw and uncooked, suggesting a cold preparation style. The dish is displayed on a table surrounded by its individual components and various condiments.

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: The Ceviche de Pescado is a dish of raw fish marinated in citrus juices, mixed with sliced red onions, halved red chili peppers, and garnished with cilantro. The ingredients are presented in a ceramic bowl, topped with a lime wedge. The bowl is placed on a wooden cutting board surrounded by additional ingredients and garnishes.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: The dish consists of stir-fried chicken, red chilies, and Thai basil leaves, served with a portion of white rice on a decorative plate. The chicken is cooked in a savory sauce and mixed with various ingredients. The plate is garnished with additional Thai basil leaves and presented on a light-colored surface surrounded by scattered ingredients and seasonings.

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: Sliced tomatoes and mozzarella cheese are arranged on a white plate, garnished with fresh basil leaves and drizzled with a dark sauce and oil. The dish is seasoned with black pepper. The salad is presented on a wooden board with a bowl of dark sauce and a fork nearby.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The pumpkin risotto is presented in a black pan, showcasing a creamy rice dish topped with diced pumpkin, thinly sliced red onions, and a pat of butter, finished with a sprinkle of black pepper. The cooking style appears to be stovetop preparation, with the ingredients visibly combined in the pan. The dish is surrounded by various ingredients and cooking elements, such as salt, butter, and a halved pumpkin.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: Shrimp are cooked in a garlic butter sauce and presented in a black skillet. The dish is garnished with parsley and served on a wooden tray surrounded by ingredients, including lemon wedges and garlic cloves. The skillet is accompanied by a fork and knife on a napkin.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or veggies.
image_description: The Roasted Red Pepper Hummus is a creamy beige dip garnished with chickpeas, roasted red peppers, and chili peppers, and drizzled with oil. The hummus is presented in a dark bowl, surrounded by various ingredients and seasonings. The dish is artfully arranged, with a visually appealing pattern of toppings and a sprinkle of spices.

name: Garlic Naan
directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.
image_description: Five pieces of garlic naan are arranged on a plate, topped with garlic cloves and herbs, and served with a small bowl of garlic cloves in the center. The naan appears to be cooked, with visible char marks on its surface. The dish is presented on a gray plate with a fork and knife on either side.

name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in tomato sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream; season and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The dish is a rich red curry with chunks of paneer, onions, and herbs, presented in a blue bowl. The paneer is cooked in a vibrant sauce with visible spices and garnished with fresh green leaves. The curry is served in a shallow blue bowl against a dark blue background.

name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.
image_description: This Coconut Curry Lentil Soup is a vibrant yellow-orange curry made with cooked lentils, presented in a brown ceramic bowl. The dish is garnished with dried red chilies, onions, and herbs, and topped with a swirl of white cream and black spices. The bowl is surrounded by various ingredients and spices, adding to the warm and inviting presentation.

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: A gyro wrap filled with sliced meat, tomatoes, cucumbers, and red onions, topped with a dollop of white sauce, is wrapped in a toasted pita bread. The wrap is placed on a wooden board lined with parchment paper. A small bowl of white sauce is visible beside the wrap.

name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: A roasted chicken is presented on a clay platter, broken down into eight pieces and arranged in a circular pattern. The chicken is golden brown and seasoned with various spices and herbs, surrounded by slices of lime and dried citrus. The dish is garnished with additional lime slices and spices on the platter and surrounding surface.

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.
Top with mango salsa (mango, onion, cilantro, lime juice).
Bake 10 minutes to finish cooking.
image_description: Grilled chicken breasts are served on a plate, topped with a vibrant mango salsa made with diced mango, red onion, and red pepper, and garnished with cilantro and lime wedges. The dish is presented on a white plate with a brown rim, set against a dark background. The chicken and salsa are arranged artfully, creating a visually appealing composition.

name: Rice Paper Rolls with Peanut Dip
directions: Soak rice papers; fill with noodles, greens, and protein.
Roll tightly; serve with peanut dip.
image_description: Rice paper rolls filled with shrimp, vegetables, and rice noodles are arranged on a round wicker platter with a bowl of peanut sauce in the center, garnished with sesame seeds and mint. The platter is surrounded by fresh ingredients, including lettuce, cucumber, carrots, and noodles. The dish is presented with chopsticks and small bowls of accompaniments.

name: Beef Nachos
directions: Cook beef with seasoning.
Layer chips, beef, and cheese; bake until cheese melts.
Top with beans, salsa, sour cream, and jalapenos.
image_description: The beef nachos are presented on a large metal platter, topped with tortilla chips, ground beef, baked beans, sliced jalapeños, and melted cheese, finished with a dollop of sour cream. The dish is surrounded by various accompaniments, including salsa, shredded cheese, and additional jalapeños. The platter is placed on a wooden table, accompanied by a recipe card.

name: Herbed Chicken Skewers
directions: Thread chicken onto skewers after marinating briefly.
Grill until cooked through, basting with oil and herbs.
Serve with lemon wedges.
image_description: Grilled chicken cubes are threaded onto skewers, garnished with rosemary and onions, and presented on a plate with lemon wedges and a drizzle of oil. The dish is arranged on a gray plate, surrounded by scattered rosemary sprigs and seasonings. The chicken appears to be cooked and seasoned with herbs and spices.

name: Coconut Shrimp Curry
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add coconut milk and vegetables; simmer 10 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook until pink and serve.
image_description: The Coconut Shrimp Curry is a vibrant dish featuring succulent shrimp, sliced onions, bell peppers, and green chilies in a rich yellow curry sauce. The ingredients are cooked together in a large pan, showcasing a sautéed or stir-fried preparation style. The curry is presented in the pan, surrounded by various ingredients and spices, highlighting the components that make up the dish.

name: Herbed Mushroom Risotto
directions: Sauté onion and mushrooms; add rice and toast.
Deglaze with wine; add broth gradually until creamy.
image_description: Herbed Mushroom Risotto is served in a brown ceramic bowl, featuring a creamy risotto topped with sautéed mushrooms and garnished with fresh herbs. The dish is presented on a gray surface, surrounded by various ingredients and cooking elements. The risotto is plated on a beige napkin, accompanied by a fork and knife.

name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
directions: Mix all ingredients into a smooth batter.
Cook on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and cook through.
image_description: A golden-brown pancake is centered on a silver platter, topped with a dollop of yellow spread and powdered sugar. The platter is surrounded by various accompaniments, including butter, lemon, and condiments in small bowls. The dish is presented with a variety of toppings and sides, arranged artfully on the platter.

name: Egg Fried Rice
directions: Scramble eggs in a wok; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables, add rice, then eggs.
Season with soy sauce and scallions.
image_description: The egg fried rice is cooked with peas, carrots, and scrambled eggs, and topped with four fried eggs and black sesame seeds. The dish is presented in a dark pan, garnished with green onions and served with soy sauce on the side. The ingredients are mixed and cooked together, creating a savory and filling meal.

name: Okonomiyaki (Japanese Pancake)
directions: Mix batter with cabbage.
Cook on a griddle; top with meat and flip.
Brush with sauce and drizzle with mayo.
image_description: The okonomiyaki is a savory pancake topped with shrimp, shredded lettuce, and drizzled with mayonnaise and a dark sauce, served on a round plate with a bed of shredded lettuce. The dish is garnished with a sprinkle of dried seaweed flakes around the pancake. It is presented on a wooden table with additional condiments in small bowls nearby.

name: Kung Pao Chicken

In the same wok, sauté garlic, ginger, and dried chilies until fragrant.
Return chicken to the wok, add the peanuts and the sauce mixture.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

Gently add the tofu cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve.

Heat oil in a wok and sear beef at high heat until browned; remove.
Stir-fry ginger for 30 seconds, then add broccoli, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Return beef to the wok and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.

Add soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; simmer until the sugar dissolves.

Pour in water and immediately cover with a lid to steam for 5-7 minutes.
Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.
